thread:
matt_sales: SolarWind POC request — they want to run `sw-14b-ft-v4` next Tue. Need a quick compatibility + SOW estimate. Anyone available?

rachel_engineer: @matt_sales quick q do they use a custom tokenizer or any native CUDA ops?

matt_sales: they attached an artifact: llama-tokenizer-v3 + wordpiece ngram postproc. also a custom CUDA ngram operator (binary provided). POC expected peak ~12 qps, steady 6-8.

alex_infra: Custom CUDA binary = blocker for hosted. For Dedicated we can attempt a shim but we'd need to vet the binary and rebuild kernels; for Private we can install with customer approval.

jordan_sre: Perf-wise: prompts avg ~800 tokens, max ~1536. If they accept int8 quant fallback we can run smaller GPU footprint. If they require FP16/no-quant, plan for 2x H100-80GB or 2x A100-80GB depending on availability.

liz_solutions: Security questionnaire flags: customer-managed KMS required, audit logs per request, and SCIM provisioning. Private VPC allowed but legal sign-off needed. Timeline depends on HSM vs KMS.

rachel_engineer: Proposed adapter path: 1) tokenizer mapping job to convert vocab -> Redwood runtime (usually trivial), 2) binary vet + shim or replace op with equivalent in our kernel set (risky), 3) smoke tests + perf run. Estimate adapter eng work 2-4 engineer-days if op can be shimmed; 5+ days if we need a kernel reimplementation.

matt_sales: can you give numbers for SOW so I can share with the customer?

jordan_sre: Ballpark: one-time eng effort 3-6 days (adapter + tests). Infra lead time: Dedicated pool 2-3 days to provision (if capacity free), Private VPC + KMS ~5-7 days, Private + HSM ~10-14 days including compliance. Monthly commit: Dedicated ~ $12k-$18k; Private w/KMS ~$18k-$24k; with HSM add-on ~$6k/mo.

alex_infra: Operational notes: need network egress rules for their SSO & KMS endpoints, and ability to accept their CUDA binary for verification. Also recommend enabling KV/prefix caching to hit p95 targets.

liz_solutions: I'll start the security questionnaire handoff and SSO checklist. Also draft an SLA addendum for Private deploy. Need their SAML metadata and KMS ARN.

rachel_engineer: Risk matrix: custom CUDA op = high risk (can block fast delivery). Tokenizer mapping = low-medium (one-off). No-quant requirement = increases infra cost.

matt_sales: action items: @rachel_engineer produce adapter checklist + test harness. @alex_infra produce exact SKU recommendation and network/runbook. @liz_solutions kick off security + SAML/KMS collection. I'll ask customer if int8 is acceptable or if HSM is mandatory now.

ops-bot: ticket created: SW-POC-871 (sales/infrastructure).

rachel_engineer: test harness snippet below:
```
# smoke test harness
MODEL=sw-14b-ft-v4
SEQ=800
BATCH=1
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"'${MODEL}'","input":"hello test"}'
```

alex_infra: perf target suggestion: p95 < 300ms for 1-token continuation at 10 qps. If they need <200ms we should enforce KV prefix caching and smaller context or a quantized fallback.

liz_solutions: Noted. I'll include HSM vs KMS timelines in the SOW draft.

matt_sales: Thanks team. I'll update once customer confirms KMS/HSM and int8 tolerance. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ticket SW-POC-871 updated: assignees [rachel_engineer, alex_infra, liz_solutions].
